objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the SQL Injection lesson to read the flag from the table flags of the lesson's database schema.
hints: The SQL Injection lesson builds its user lookup query by concatenating your input into a string.
The flag is not in the users table the lesson queries but in another table of the same schema, named flags: think about how to combine the results of two queries.

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which request parameter of the SQL Injection lesson ends up in the query? (parameter name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class does the lesson teach?

steps.title: Identify the database
steps.prompt: Which database engine stores the lesson's data?

steps.title: Reach another table
steps.prompt: Which SQL operator appends the rows of a second query to the lesson's results? (keyword)
